products.description:
Take over Google Workspace operations the day the project goes live

When a Google Workspace project goes live, someone has to run it — and without a structured operations model, day-2 becomes firefighting. This solution is the Day-2 administration & operations runbook: the organizational-unit (OU) design and configuration-policy governance that structures the tenant, plus the steady-state operating model — routine admin SOPs, health checks, monitoring/alerting, request and incident handling, change control, and config-drift detection — so operations are owned, repeatable, and auditable from go-live onward.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the operations model + the OU/policy-governance architecture (OU tree, policy inheritance, settings baseline, change control) and the Assess→Design→Configure→Pilot→Validate→Expand model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, admin-role delegation model, monitoring targets, change-control process).
  • Implementation Guide — design the OU tree + policy inheritance and settings baseline, establish admin-role delegation, stand up monitoring/alerting + health checks, and codify the runbooks (routine SOPs, request/incident handling, change control, config-drift detection) — each artifact named.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or operations helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health or control check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Runbook Library + validation gates (OU/policies applied, monitoring live, runbooks exercised) plus Best Practices for a durable day-2 operations practice.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Google Workspace operations owned from go-live — a governed OU/policy structure, delegated admin roles, live monitoring, and exercised runbooks — repeatable, auditable, no firefighting.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • admin_role_auditor.py — read-only audit of Google Workspace admin-role assignments; flags
    • config_drift_detector.py — read-only comparison of live per-OU governance settings against a curated
    • health_check_report.py — read-only Google Workspace health/monitoring report from the Admin SDK
    • ops_config_helper.py — safe operations helper backing the lifecycle runbooks (offboarding, group and
    • ou_policy_assessment.py — read-only discovery of the Google Workspace OU tree, users/admins per OU,

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
